notes: Sporeling: a walking fungus colony. A big mushroom-cap head (cream with rust spots; the brown variant is the inverse, a rust cap with cream spots), a fibrous brown body, a small colony of caps sprouting off the back, rooty stub legs with a short slow stride, and spore puffs on the glow layers (head_glow and torso_glow have 2 drifting frames per variant: alternate them at ~4 fps). Outfit mask = sash, wrist and ankle wraps. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.

glow.notes: per head variant, a list of glow frames: alternate them at 4 fps
